# ona_environment_class (List Resource)

Lists environment classes for AWS EC2 and GCP runners. Environment classes for Ona-hosted (managed/cloud) runners are excluded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "ona_environment_class" "all" {
  provider         = ona
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to include only enabled (`true`) or disabled (`false`) environment classes.
- `providers` (List of String) Runner providers to include. Supported values are `aws_ec2` and `gcp`.
- `runner_ids` (List of String) Runner IDs to include.
